title: Importing Into Cloud & Managed Databases
description: Cloud SQL, RDS, and DigitalOcean managed databases each have their own import quirks — SSL, buckets, and no SUPER privilege.
bullets: Managed databases rarely grant SUPER — strip DEFINER clauses first
Some platforms import from a bucket, not your local disk
SSL is often mandatory; pass the CA certificate
Run the import close to the database to avoid timeouts
